environment: Windows 11 Pro x64, MSVC 19.51, GNS 1.6.1 and OpenSSL 3.6.5 via vcpkg 65a2c23, loopback; real time
game_exe_sha256: N/A (prototype does not touch the game)
objective: Implement ChatGPT review #8 FB-8-01..05: cookie-aware pending replacement, secure reliable channel, key/invitation provisioning with secure executables and E2E/soak, idle timeout, KI-27 wording.
hypothesis: The secure transport can carry all game traffic of the real executables, including reliable messages, with provisioned keys and fail-closed startup, without regressing either backend.
procedure: Implemented FB-8-01/02/03/04 (see docs/d013-evaluation.md, D-016). Tests: forged-ClientHello reconnect test with a mutation check; reliable exactness/backpressure/interleave/loss-accounting/close-drain/keepalive; identity file, invitation and CLI negative tests; scripts/secure-e2e.ps1 (positive + 5 negative processes) and soak.ps1 -Secure on both backends. Full battery x2 (plaintext soaks, secure soaks, all suites, E2E, asymmetric, secure E2E, KI-27 stress).
expected_result: All tests and soaks pass on both transports, plaintext and secure; negatives refused; no key material in logs.
observed_result: Defects found and fixed during the work: (1) GNS adapter dropped messages that arrived before a peer close (new contract test, 20/20 delivered before Disconnected); (2) GNS status callbacks piled up ('Callbacks backing up', 895 warnings in the KI-27 probe) because the runtime outlives instances -> drained on close (0); (3) decorator dropped messages arriving in the same poll as a disconnect; (4) DtlsSession sent with now=0, so UDP-simulated latency and jitter were never applied to DTLS traffic (KI-34): the first secure UDP soaks are invalid for latency (soak-2026-10-24-034129-lan-udp-sec-g4: 43/43; rtt p50/p99 3.0/3.0 ms; recovery 506.0 ms | soak-2026-10-24-034337-moderate-udp-sec-g4: 43/43; rtt p50/p99 3.0/3.1 ms; recovery 1009.0 ms | soak-2026-10-24-034546-harsh-udp-sec-g4: 43/43; rtt p50/p99 3.0/3.1 ms; recovery 2009.0 ms), and earlier UDP DTLS latency claims (EXP-018/019) are corrected; (5) with real jitter the reliable channel livelocked (12041 retransmits, 0/9 delivered; log tests-dtls-reliable-livelock-2026-10-24.json) because whole-window bursts exceeded DTLS's 64-record replay window -> at most 32 in flight. FB-8-01: reconnect under forged ClientHellos from the player address authenticated in about 50 ms (replaced 6 unverified, ignored 3 after the cookie verified); the mutation restoring the old rule fails the test. Reliable: 300/300 each way in order under 15% loss + 10% dup + jitter; Backpressure at 256; 5/5 lost messages counted; only DTLS records on the wire. Identity: 9 CLI negatives refused; DPAPI + user-only DACL; broadened ACL, corrupt and foreign files refused. Secure E2E passed on both backends (secure-e2e-2026-10-24-050618-gns, secure-e2e-2026-10-24-050649-udp). Asymmetric 4/4 (asym-2026-10-24-050410-uplink-outage-gns, asym-2026-10-24-050442-host-jitter-client-outage-gns, asym-2026-10-24-050514-uplink-outage-udp, asym-2026-10-24-050546-host-jitter-client-outage-udp). KI-27 stress 0 assertions in 10 processes.
